group.ja: 重力と長距離相互作用

summary.ja: 既存配布版：孤立した3次元粒子の重力加速度をoctreeで近似する。公開例はG=1のPlummer軟化核に対し、質量単極子または同じ軟化核の完全な二次モーメント項を使い、直接和と比較する。 追加固定例：冷たいPlummer密度由来32粒子の短時間力学。条件と検証範囲は各配布版で確認してください。
summary.en: Existing releases: Approximate isolated 3D particle gravity with an octree. The public example uses G=1 and a Plummer-softened kernel, with a monopole or the same kernel's full second-moment term, compared with direct summation. Additional fixed examples: Short-time32body dynamics from a cold Plummer-density sample. See each release for assumptions and checked scope.

code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Barnes, J. & Hut, P. (1986). A hierarchical O(N log N) force-calculation algorithm.
references.scope: Octree hierarchical force evaluation; does not by itself document the atlas's full second-moment expansion of a Plummer-softened kernel.

supports.ja: 立方体を八分割する階層的な力計算の出典。今回確認した抄録から、軟化核や二次モーメント式の細部まで確認済みとはしない。
supports.en: Supports hierarchical octree force evaluation; the reviewed abstract does not establish the atlas's softened second-moment formula.

verification.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata returned by web search; full article body not reviewed.

assumptions: Positions are finite (N,3), masses positive and finite, and N≥1; ε=softening>0, theta≥0 and order is 0 or 2.
A node is accepted when s/d<theta, with s=2×half and d measured to its center of mass. Target-containing cells are always opened; leaves exclude self terms.
The acceleration kernel is −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2). order=2 adds the full Taylor term from S=Σmδδᵀ, retaining trace(S) for the softened kernel.
units: Dimensionless G=1. Positions and softening share a length unit and masses use one consistent unit. With scales L₀,M₀, acceleration is restored with GM₀/L₀².
boundary_conditions: Isolated boundaries without periodic images; the softened potential −Gm/√(r²+ε²) tends to zero at infinity. This is a different boundary problem from periodic PM, Ewald or TreePM.

limitations.ja: 既存配布版の制約：静的な力の教育例で、時間積分・宇宙膨張・周期境界・FMMを含まない。thetaは厳密な誤差上限ではなく、order=2がすべての配置で常に改善する保証もない。対象ごとの近似なので厳密な作用反作用・全運動量保存は保証せず、相互作用回数は実時間や全分布でのO(N log N)の実測ではない。 今回の追加固定例：冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
limitations.en: Limits of existing releases: A static-force educational example without time integration, expansion, periodic images or FMM. theta is not a rigorous error bound, and order=2 need not improve every configuration. Targetwise approximation does not guarantee exact action–reaction/total-momentum conservation. Interaction counts are not timings or empirical complexity guarantees for every distribution. Additional fixed examples: Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim.

metadata_review.level: method-specific sources and implementation inspected; no new numerical rerun

supplemental_review.level: Frozen fixed-input source,independent review,actual pytest/main and independently extracted ZIP; see each new release for exact reference independence and failed-attempt history.

assumptions_ja: 位置は有限の(N,3)配列、質量は正かつ有限、粒子数は1以上。softening=ε>0、theta≥0、orderは0または2。
節点の一辺s=2×half、質量中心までの距離dについて s/d<theta なら受理する。ただし対象粒子を含むセルは必ず開き、葉では自己項を除く。
加速度核は −m r/(r²+ε²)^(3/2)。order=2はS=Σmδδᵀの完全なTaylor項を加え、軟化された核に必要なtrace(S)項も保持する。
units_ja: 無次元のG=1。位置と軟化長は同じ長さ単位、質量には一貫した単位を使う。長さL₀・質量M₀で次元を戻す場合、加速度の尺度はGM₀/L₀²。
boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立境界で周期像を加えない。軟化核のポテンシャル −Gm/√(r²+ε²) は無限遠で零となる規約。周期PM・Ewald・TreePMとは異なる境界問題。

variant.en: Barnes–Hut octree with geometric s/d opening, monopole or full softened second moment; theta=0 fully opens the tree.

summary.ja: 同じ軟化有限N ODEで時間誤差と木近似誤差を分け、独立DOP853・直接力と収支を比較。
summary.en: Separate time and tree-force errors for the same softened finite-N ODE with independent DOP853/direct-force references and budgets.

assumptions.ja: 固定32等質量・切断r3の密度由来反対称座標、初速0、epsilon.05、T.2。密度尺度a1とは別。
assumptions.en: Fixed32equal masses,antipodal truncatedr3 density-derived positions,zero velocity,epsilon.05,T.2; density scalea1 differs from pair softening.

algorithm.ja: 直接KDK20/40/80steps、最細でtheta0/.35/.6のfull second-moment BH。独立scalar対力+DOP853を2許容値で資格確認。
algorithm.en: Direct KDK20/40/80steps; finest-dt full second-moment BHtheta0/.35/.6; qualify independent scalar-pair DOP853 at two tolerances.

validation.ja: 非零の固定尺度、同一座標上の力、同期E/P/L/COM、theta0対照、非対称静的probe。
validation.en: Nonzero fixed scales,same-position force comparison,synchronizedE/P/L/COM,theta0 control and asymmetric static probe.

limits.ja: 冷たい有限N初期値で平衡Plummer分布/連続球厳密軌道ではありません。BHの一般相反性・大域symplectic性は主張しません。
limits.en: Cold finite-N initial value,not an equilibrium Plummer DF or exact continuum orbit. No general BH reciprocity/global symplecticity claim.
